name: Gong MCP
description: Opens Gong revenue intelligence to agents — query recorded calls, transcripts, and deal signals, and act on them across the surrounding sales stack.

skills.name: Call Retrieval
skills.description: Fetches recorded sales calls and their transcripts filtered by account, rep, date range, or deal stage.

skills.name: Deal Signals
skills.description: Surfaces risk and momentum signals Gong derives from conversation data across an active pipeline.

skills.name: Stack Actions
skills.description: Acts as an MCP client against other connected systems so agents can follow up on what a call revealed.
